from collections import deque
from time import monotonic

# Each attribute is represented by its owner's position (1 through 8).
categories = [
    "Eagles Chiefs Dolphins Ravens Cowboys Falcons Cardinals Rams".split(),
    "Ducati Bajaj Yamaha Benelli Kawasaki Buell Suzuki Honda".split(),
    "Michelle Mandy Rajiv Ali Mallika Wang Mohsen Jones".split(),
    "pink teal gold violet magenta turquoise grey beige".split(),
    ["hiking", "weightlifting", "paragliding", "scuba", "basejumping",
     "running", "swimming", "snorkeling"],
    ["Dolce", "Versace", "Balenciaga", "Coach", "Gucci", "Tumi", "Polo", "Kors"],
    "Pearls Sapphires Corals Diamonds Aquamarines Obsidians Moonstones Emeralds".split(),
    ["history", "mystery", "shortstory", "fantasy", "magicalrealism",
     "romance", "sciencefiction", "humor"],
]
names = sum(categories, [])
parent = {x: x for x in names}


def root(x):
    while parent[x] != x:
        parent[x] = parent[parent[x]]
        x = parent[x]
    return x


def equal(a, b):
    parent[root(a)] = root(b)


for a, b in [
    ("swimming", "Ducati"),                       # 4
    ("Cowboys", "turquoise"),                     # 9
    ("magenta", "Corals"),                        # 16
    ("running", "Cowboys"),                       # 18
    ("Ali", "running"),                           # 20
    ("Wang", "scuba"),                            # 22
    ("basejumping", "sciencefiction"),            # 29
    ("Jones", "Eagles"),                          # 30
    ("Dolphins", "Obsidians"),                    # 36
    ("Buell", "Polo"),                            # 37
    ("Falcons", "scuba"),                         # 38
    ("Gucci", "Pearls"),                          # 40
    ("Benelli", "Chiefs"),                        # 45
    ("Pearls", "Ducati"),                         # 49
    ("Falcons", "magicalrealism"),                # 50
]:
    equal(a, b)

roots = sorted({root(x) for x in names})
index = {r: i for i, r in enumerate(roots)}
var = {x: index[root(x)] for x in names}
n = len(roots)
ALL = (1 << 8) - 1
initial = [ALL] * n
groups = [[var[x] for x in category] for category in categories]
assert all(len(set(g)) == 8 for g in groups)

# tables[(a,b)][p] gives all allowed positions for b when a is at p.
tables = {}


def constraint(a, b, predicate):
    a, b = var[a], var[b]
    if a == b:
        initial[a] &= sum(1 << p for p in range(8)
                          if predicate(p + 1, p + 1))
        return
    for u, v, pred in [
        (a, b, predicate),
        (b, a, lambda p, q: predicate(q, p)),
    ]:
        mask = [
            sum(1 << q for q in range(8) if pred(p + 1, q + 1))
            for p in range(8)
        ]
        if (u, v) in tables:
            mask = [x & y for x, y in zip(tables[u, v], mask)]
        tables[u, v] = mask


for category in categories:
    for i, a in enumerate(category):
        for b in category[i + 1:]:
            constraint(a, b, lambda p, q: p != q)


def left(a, b):
    constraint(a, b, lambda p, q: p + 1 == q)


def before(a, b):
    constraint(a, b, lambda p, q: p < q)


def next_to(a, b):
    constraint(a, b, lambda p, q: abs(p - q) == 1)


def fix(a, positions):
    initial[var[a]] &= sum(1 << (p - 1) for p in positions)


left("Chiefs", "Emeralds")                         # 1
left("Kors", "Gucci")                              # 2
left("Moonstones", "turquoise")                    # 3
next_to("hiking", "Aquamarines")                   # 5
fix("snorkeling", [1, 8])                          # 6
constraint("Buell", "Versace", lambda p, q: p != q) # 7
next_to("Ravens", "humor")                         # 8
before("Sapphires", "romance")                     # 10
fix("Gucci", [1, 8])                               # 11
next_to("Michelle", "Yamaha")                      # 12
fix("gold", [1, 8])                                # 13
fix("history", [1, 8])                             # 14
left("Kawasaki", "swimming")                       # 15
fix("violet", [1])                                 # 17
left("Sapphires", "gold")                          # 19
next_to("Gucci", "scuba")                          # 21
fix("Coach", [3])                                  # 23
before("Obsidians", "Mandy")                       # 24
before("Mandy", "sciencefiction")
left("Ravens", "grey")                             # 25
before("Corals", "Benelli")                        # 26
before("Benelli", "Honda")
before("Falcons", "Mohsen")                        # 27
fix("Aquamarines", [1, 8])                         # 28
left("Aquamarines", "teal")                        # 31
before("Suzuki", "Versace")                        # 32
before("Versace", "Coach")
before("Cardinals", "Rajiv")                       # 33
fix("Jones", [1, 8])                               # 34
before("Yamaha", "paragliding")                    # 35
before("pink", "Emeralds")                         # 39
before("Emeralds", "Ducati")
left("Ravens", "Obsidians")                        # 41
left("Aquamarines", "Michelle")                    # 42
left("mystery", "Dolce")                           # 43
before("sciencefiction", "shortstory")             # 44
left("basejumping", "Emeralds")                    # 46
left("history", "Ravens")                          # 47
left("Dolce", "Balenciaga")                        # 48

neighbors = [[] for _ in range(n)]
for (a, b), table in tables.items():
    neighbors[b].append((a, table))

membership = [[] for _ in range(n)]
for g in groups:
    for a in g:
        membership[a].append(g)

deadline = monotonic() + 4.4


class TimeLimit(Exception):
    pass


def propagate(d):
    queue = deque(range(n))
    queued = set(queue)

    def narrow(a, mask):
        new = d[a] & mask
        if not new:
            return False
        if new != d[a]:
            d[a] = new
            if a not in queued:
                queued.add(a)
                queue.append(a)
        return True

    while queue:
        if monotonic() > deadline:
            raise TimeLimit
        b = queue.popleft()
        queued.remove(b)
        if not d[b]:
            return False
        for a, table in neighbors[b]:
            mask = d[a]
            supported = 0
            while mask:
                bit = mask & -mask
                mask -= bit
                if table[bit.bit_length() - 1] & d[b]:
                    supported |= bit
            if not narrow(a, supported):
                return False

        # Every position must occur exactly once in each category.
        for g in membership[b]:
            for p in range(8):
                bit = 1 << p
                holders = [a for a in g if d[a] & bit]
                if not holders:
                    return False
                if len(holders) == 1 and not narrow(holders[0], bit):
                    return False
    return True


def search(d):
    if not propagate(d):
        return None
    undecided = [a for a in range(n) if d[a].bit_count() > 1]
    if not undecided:
        # Verify every encoded relation on the completed assignment.
        assert all(table[d[a].bit_length() - 1] & d[b]
                   for (a, b), table in tables.items())
        assert all(len({d[a] for a in g}) == 8 for g in groups)
        return d
    a = min(undecided, key=lambda x: (d[x].bit_count(), -len(neighbors[x])))
    remaining = d[a]
    while remaining:
        bit = remaining & -remaining
        remaining -= bit
        child = d[:]
        child[a] = bit
        result = search(child)
        if result is not None:
            return result
    return None


possible = []
witnesses = {}
try:
    # Exhaustive satisfiability test for every possible answer, not sampling.
    for position in range(1, 9):
        d = initial[:]
        d[var["Rajiv"]] &= 1 << (position - 1)
        solution = search(d)
        if solution is not None:
            possible.append(position)
            witnesses[position] = solution

    print("Possible positions for Rajiv:", possible)
    if len(possible) == 1:
        print("Expected answer:", possible[0])
        print("A complete satisfying arrangement (positions 1 through 8):")
        solution = witnesses[possible[0]]
        for p in range(1, 9):
            row = [
                next(x for x in category
                     if solution[var[x]] == 1 << (p - 1))
                for category in categories
            ]
            print(p, "|", " | ".join(row))
        print("Submitted answer is incomplete and gives no position for Rajiv.")
        print("CHECK FAIL")
    elif possible:
        print("The clues do not determine a unique position.")
        print("Submitted answer gives no position for Rajiv.")
        print("CHECK FAIL")
    else:
        print("No arrangement satisfies all the clues.")
        print("CHECK FAIL")
except TimeLimit:
    print("Verified feasible positions so far:", possible)
    print("UNSUPPORTED: exhaustive verification exceeded the time budget.")
    print("CHECK UNKNOWN")
